symptoms: formula me #REF aa raha hai
excel shows #REF error after deleting a column
row delete kiya to formula toot gaya
sheet delete karne ke baad sab cells mein ref error
my vlookup gives ref error
formula broken reference

causes.title_en: A row, column or sheet the formula used was deleted
causes.title_hi: Formula jis row, column ya sheet ko use karta tha woh delete ho gaya

causes.title_en: The lookup column number is outside the table (VLOOKUP/INDEX)
causes.title_hi: VLOOKUP/INDEX mein column number table se bahar hai

causes.title_en: It points to another file that moved or was renamed
causes.title_hi: Doosri file ka link hai jo hil gayi ya naam badal gaya

fixes.steps_en: I find every #REF! formula, rebuild it from the same formula in the neighbouring rows, and give you the fixed copy with a list of what changed.
fixes.steps_hi: Main har #REF! formula dhoondta hoon, aas-paas ki rows ke same formula se dobara banata hoon, aur fixed copy de deta hoon, badlav ki list ke saath.

fixes.steps_en: I correct the column number (or switch VLOOKUP to XLOOKUP, which can't break this way) and show you before and after.
fixes.steps_hi: Main column number theek karta hoon (ya VLOOKUP ko XLOOKUP mein badal deta hoon jo aise nahi tootta) aur pehle-baad dikhata hoon.

fixes.steps_en: Upload the other file too and I'll relink it. Or in Excel: Data > Edit Links > Change Source, and pick the file.
fixes.steps_hi: Doosri file bhi upload karo, main link jod dunga. Ya Excel mein: Data > Edit Links > Change Source, aur file chuno.

verify.en: No cell in the workbook shows #REF! and the totals match the old values where the old values were right.
verify.hi: Workbook mein kahin #REF! nahi dikhta aur totals purani sahi values se milte hain.

test_phrases: after I removed a sheet all the totals say REF
column hataya aur ab har jagah ref likha aa raha
शीट डिलीट करने के बाद फॉर्मूला में रेफ एरर आ रहा है

title_en: VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP gives #N/A although the value is there
title_hi: Value hai phir bhi VLOOKUP #N/A de raha hai
symptoms: vlookup not working even though value exists
vlookup #N/A aa raha hai jabki data hai
dono sheet mein same id hai par match nahi ho raha
lookup returns n/a for some rows only
xlookup not finding the value
do sheets ka data match nahi ho raha
वीलुकअप में N/A आ रहा है
दोनों लिस्ट में नाम है पर मैच नहीं हो रहा
lookup value hai phir bhi NA aata hai
code same hai fir bhi vlookup N/A de raha
vlookup can't find an id that is there

causes.title_en: Hidden spaces before or after the value
causes.title_hi: Value ke aage-peeche chhupe hue space

causes.title_en: One side is a number, the other is a number stored as text
causes.title_hi: Ek taraf number hai, doosri taraf text ki tarah save number

causes.title_en: The last argument is TRUE/blank (approximate match) on unsorted data
causes.title_hi: Aakhri argument TRUE ya khaali hai (approximate match) aur data sorted nahi hai

causes.title_en: The value really isn't in the lookup table
causes.title_hi: Value sach mein lookup table mein nahi hai

fixes.steps_en: I remove the hidden spaces in both key columns and re-run the lookup.
fixes.steps_hi: Main dono key columns se chhupe space hata kar lookup dobara chalata hoon.

fixes.steps_en: I convert the text-numbers to real numbers on both sides so they match.
fixes.steps_hi: Main dono taraf text wale numbers ko asli number bana deta hoon taaki match ho.

fixes.steps_en: I set exact match (FALSE / 0) in every lookup formula.
fixes.steps_hi: Main har lookup formula mein exact match (FALSE / 0) laga deta hoon.

fixes.steps_en: I list exactly which values are missing from the lookup table, so you know what to add.
fixes.steps_hi: Main list deta hoon ki kaunsi values lookup table mein nahi hain, taaki aap jod sako.

verify.en: The #N/A cells now show values, and the only ones left are values listed as really missing.
verify.hi: #N/A wale cells mein ab value aati hai, bas wahi bache jo sach mein missing list mein hain.

test_phrases: lookup can't find names that are clearly in the other sheet
id dono jagah same hai phir bhi NA dikha raha
दोनों शीट में आईडी है फिर भी वीलुकअप काम नहीं कर रहा

title_en: SUM shows 0 or numbers don't add up (numbers stored as text)
title_hi: SUM 0 aa raha hai, numbers jud nahi rahe (text ki tarah save hain)
symptoms: sum formula shows zero
total 0 aa raha hai
numbers left side aligned hain aur add nahi ho rahe
green triangle in cells number stored as text
csv import ke baad numbers jud nahi rahe
excel not adding numbers
column ka total nahi aa raha
the total of my column comes out wrong or zero
jod nahi ho raha numbers ka
autosum not working on these numbers
amount jodne par 0 dikhata hai
numbers add karne par kuch nahi hota

causes.title_en: The numbers are saved as text (often after a CSV/ERP/bank export)
causes.title_hi: Numbers text ki tarah save hain (aksar CSV/ERP/bank export ke baad)

causes.title_en: Commas, currency signs or non-breaking spaces inside the numbers
causes.title_hi: Numbers ke andar comma, ₹ sign ya ajeeb space

fixes.steps_en: I convert every text-number in the sheet to a real number and keep the formatting.
fixes.steps_hi: Main sheet ke saare text-numbers ko asli number bana deta hoon, formatting wahi rehti hai.

fixes.steps_en: I strip ₹, $, commas and odd spaces, then convert to numbers. You see a sample before and after.
fixes.steps_hi: Main ₹, $, comma aur ajeeb space hata kar number banata hoon. Pehle-baad ka sample dikhata hoon.

verify.en: SUM gives the right total and the cells are right-aligned numbers.
verify.hi: SUM sahi total deta hai aur cells right side wale number hain.

test_phrases: my total column adds up to nothing
amount column ka jod hi nahi ho raha
एक्सेल में टोटल ज़ीरो आ रहा है

title_en: Excel file won't open / is corrupted
title_hi: Excel file khul nahi rahi / corrupt ho gayi
symptoms: excel file corrupt ho gayi
we found a problem with some content in the file
file open nahi ho rahi excel
excel cannot open the file because the file format or extension is not valid
file khulte hi error aata hai
my workbook is damaged

causes.title_en: The file's inner parts are damaged (crash, bad copy, interrupted download)
causes.title_hi: File andar se kharab ho gayi (crash, adhoori copy ya download)

causes.title_en: The file isn't really .xlsx (it's CSV, HTML or .xls renamed)
causes.title_hi: File asal mein .xlsx nahi hai (CSV, HTML ya .xls ka naam badla hai)

fixes.steps_en: I open the file piece by piece, recover every sheet and value I can read, and give you a clean new file with a list of anything I couldn't save.
fixes.steps_hi: Main file ko tukdon mein kholta hoon, jitni sheets aur values padh sakta hoon bachata hoon, aur nayi saaf file deta hoon, jo nahi bacha uski list ke saath.

fixes.steps_en: I detect the real format and convert it to a proper .xlsx.
fixes.steps_hi: Main asli format pehchaan kar use sahi .xlsx bana deta hoon.

verify.en: The new file opens in Excel without a repair message and has the same sheets and row counts.
verify.hi: Nayi file Excel mein bina repair message ke khulti hai aur sheets aur rows utni hi hain.

test_phrases: excel says the file is broken and wants to repair it
kal tak file chal rahi thi aaj khul hi nahi rahi
मेरी एक्सेल फाइल खराब हो गई है खुल नहीं रही

title_en: Aging report puts invoices in the wrong bucket
title_hi: Aging report mein invoice galat bucket mein ja rahe
symptoms: aging report galat aa raha hai
sab invoices 90+ mein dikh rahe hain
ageing days bahut bade number aa rahe 45000 jaise
aging buckets not updating every day
days overdue stuck on yesterday's number
aging formula shows #VALUE for some invoices
kuch bills ka ageing blank ya error aa raha
due date khaali hai to bhi 90+ dikha raha
ageing kal se change hi nahi hua
एजिंग रिपोर्ट गलत आ रही है
सब बिल 90+ में दिख रहे
एजिंग रोज़ अपडेट नहीं होती
ageing report shows everything over 90 days
my ageing report is wrong, all bills in 90 plus
aging days not changing day to day

causes.title_en: Some due dates are text, not real dates
causes.title_hi: Kuch due dates text hain, asli date nahi

causes.title_en: Blank due dates count as day 0 (year 1900), so they land in 90+
causes.title_hi: Khaali due date 1900 ki date maani jaati hai, isliye 90+ mein jaati hai

causes.title_en: Calculation is set to Manual, so TODAY() doesn't move
causes.title_hi: Calculation Manual par hai, isliye TODAY() nahi badalta

fixes.steps_en: I convert every text due date into a real date (checking DD/MM vs MM/DD) and show you the ones I changed.
fixes.steps_hi: Main har text due date ko asli date mein badalta hoon (DD/MM vs MM/DD check karke) aur badli hui list dikhata hoon.

fixes.steps_en: I change the aging formula so a blank due date shows 'No due date' instead of 90+, and list those invoices for you to fill.
fixes.steps_hi: Main aging formula badal deta hoon taaki khaali due date par 90+ ki jagah 'No due date' aaye, aur un invoices ki list deta hoon.

fixes.steps_en: In Excel: File > Options > Formulas > Calculation options > Automatic > OK.
fixes.steps_hi: Excel mein: File > Options > Formulas > Calculation options > Automatic > OK.

verify.en: Every unpaid invoice has a bucket, none of the blank-due-date ones sit in 90+, and tomorrow the day counts go up by one.
verify.hi: Har unpaid invoice ka bucket hai, khaali due date wale 90+ mein nahi, aur kal din ki ginti ek badh jaati hai.

test_phrases: my receivables ageing puts nearly every bill in over 90 days
ageing roz update nahi hota, wahi purane din dikha raha
एजिंग रिपोर्ट में सारे बिल 90 दिन से ऊपर दिख रहे हैं

title_en: Payment received but the invoice still shows outstanding
title_hi: Payment aa gaya phir bhi invoice outstanding dikha raha
symptoms: payment aa gaya phir bhi outstanding dikha raha hai
receipt entry ki par balance kam nahi hua
paid invoice still showing as due
sumifs payment not picking up for some invoices
bank receipt invoice se match nahi ho raha
customer says paid but my sheet shows pending
kuch invoices ka collection zero dikh raha
पेमेंट आ गया फिर भी बकाया दिखा रहा
रसीद डाली पर बैलेंस कम नहीं हुआ
customer cleared invoice but it still shows open
paisa mil gaya phir bhi pending dikha raha
client ne payment kar diya phir bhi sheet mein dues baaki
party ka paisa aa gaya lekin baaki amount wahi hai
customer paid yet sheet shows balance remaining

causes.title_en: Invoice numbers have extra or hidden spaces on one side
causes.title_hi: Ek taraf invoice number mein extra ya chhupe space hain

causes.title_en: Invoice number is a number on one sheet and text on the other
causes.title_hi: Ek sheet mein invoice number number hai, doosri mein text

causes.title_en: Different styles: INV-0012 vs 12 vs inv12
causes.title_hi: Alag likhawat: INV-0012 vs 12 vs inv12

fixes.steps_en: I remove extra and hidden spaces from both invoice-number columns and show which balances changed.
fixes.steps_hi: Main dono invoice-number columns se extra aur chhupe space hata deta hoon aur dikhata hoon kaunse balance badle.

fixes.steps_en: I make both invoice-number columns the same type so every payment finds its invoice.
fixes.steps_hi: Main dono invoice-number columns ek hi type ke kar deta hoon taaki har payment apna invoice dhoond le.

fixes.steps_en: Tell me which style is right (e.g. INV-0012). Upload both sheets and I rewrite the other column in that style, then re-match.
fixes.steps_hi: Batao kaunsi likhawat sahi hai (jaise INV-0012). Dono sheets upload karo, main doosre column ko usi style mein likh kar dobara match karunga.

verify.en: Every payment line finds an invoice, and invoices paid in full show a balance of 0.
verify.hi: Har payment line ko invoice mil jaata hai, aur poore paid invoices ka balance 0 dikhta hai.

test_phrases: the client cleared the bill but my receivables sheet still has it open
party ne paisa de diya fir bhi sheet mein baaki dikha raha hai
भुगतान मिल गया फिर भी बिल बकाया दिख रहा है

title_en: Bank reconciliation doesn't tally: bank and books show different balances
title_hi: Bank reconciliation tally nahi ho raha: bank aur books ka balance alag
symptoms: bank reco tally nahi ho raha
bank balance and book balance not matching
BRS mein difference aa raha hai
statement and ledger don't agree at month end
bank statement import ke baad amounts match nahi ho rahe
bank csv amounts not matching ledger even though they look same
बैंक रिकंसिलिएशन में अंतर आ रहा है
बैंक और कैश बुक का बैलेंस नहीं मिल रहा
reconciliation off by a small amount
same entries do baar aa gayi bank statement import mein
bank ki dates ulti ho gayi import karne par
reco mein kuch entries match hi nahi hoti
बैंक स्टेटमेंट और लेजर मेल नहीं खा रहे

causes.title_en: Timing: cheques not yet cleared, deposits not yet credited
causes.title_hi: Timing: cheque abhi clear nahi hue, deposit abhi credit nahi hue

causes.title_en: Bank charges, interest or direct credits not booked yet
causes.title_hi: Bank charges, interest ya direct credit abhi book nahi hue

causes.title_en: Amounts in the bank export are text (commas, Cr/Dr, spaces)
causes.title_hi: Bank export ke amounts text hain (comma, Cr/Dr, space)

causes.title_en: Bank dates read the wrong way (DD/MM vs MM/DD)
causes.title_hi: Bank dates ulti padhi gayi (DD/MM vs MM/DD)

causes.title_en: Statement imported twice or overlapping periods
causes.title_hi: Statement do baar import hua ya period overlap

causes.title_en: A real error: wrong amount, swapped digits, missed entry
causes.title_hi: Asli galti: galat amount, ulte digits, chhooti entry

fixes.steps_en: I turn the bank amounts into real numbers (commas, spaces, Cr/Dr removed) so they can match the books.
fixes.steps_hi: Main bank amounts ko asli number bana deta hoon (comma, space, Cr/Dr hata kar) taaki books se match ho saken.

fixes.steps_en: I read the bank dates in the right order and make them real dates, then match again.
fixes.steps_hi: Main bank dates sahi order mein padh kar asli date bana deta hoon, phir dobara match karta hoon.

fixes.steps_en: I remove statement lines that came in twice (same date, amount and reference) and list them for you.
fixes.steps_hi: Main do baar aayi statement lines (same date, amount, reference) hata kar unki list dikhata hoon.

fixes.steps_en: Uncleared cheques and deposits are not errors. List them as outstanding items in the BRS; they clear next month.
fixes.steps_hi: Clear na hue cheque aur deposit galti nahi hain. BRS mein outstanding items mein likho, agle mahine clear ho jayenge.

fixes.steps_en: 1. Note the charges/interest lines from the statement. 2. Post them in your accounting software with a journal/bank entry. 3. Upload the new ledger and I match again.
fixes.steps_hi: 1. Statement se charges/interest lines note karo. 2. Accounting software mein journal/bank entry se post karo. 3. Naya ledger upload karo, main dobara match karunga.

fixes.steps_en: I compare the statement with the ledger and list every line that has no partner, plus whether the leftover difference looks like swapped digits.
fixes.steps_hi: Main statement aur ledger compare karke har bina-jodi line ki list deta hoon, aur batata hoon ki bacha fark ulte digits jaisa lagta hai ya nahi.

verify.en: Adjusted bank balance equals adjusted book balance, and every unmatched line is a listed outstanding item.
verify.hi: Adjusted bank balance aur adjusted book balance barabar, aur har unmatched line outstanding items mein likhi hai.

test_phrases: my month end bank rec is out and I cannot find why
bank wala reconciliation match hi nahi ho raha mahine ke end mein
महीने के अंत में बैंक का मिलान नहीं हो पा रहा

title_en: Card / UPI / POS settlement received is less than sales
title_hi: Card/UPI/POS ka settlement sales se kam aaya
symptoms: card settlement kam aaya
pos deposits don't match card sales
merchant payout lower than total sales
upi settlement aur sales match nahi ho rahe
swipe machine se paisa kam aaya
credit card batch doesn't match bank
कार्ड सेटलमेंट बिक्री से कम आया
पीओएस का पैसा बैंक में कम आया
payment gateway settlement short
daily card sales and bank credit not tallying
settlement report aur sales report mein fark

causes.title_en: MDR / gateway fees and GST deducted before payout
causes.title_hi: Payout se pehle MDR/gateway fees aur GST kat gaye

causes.title_en: Batch settles 1-2 days later (weekends, holidays)
causes.title_hi: Batch 1-2 din baad settle hota hai (weekend, chhutti)

causes.title_en: Refunds or chargebacks netted from the payout
causes.title_hi: Refund ya chargeback payout se kat gaye

causes.title_en: Settlement export has text amounts or odd dates
causes.title_hi: Settlement export mein text amounts ya ajeeb dates

fixes.steps_en: Payouts are net: sales minus MDR and GST on it. Compare net, not gross; the fee lines in the settlement report explain the gap.
fixes.steps_hi: Payout net hota hai: sales - MDR aur uska GST. Gross nahi, net compare karo; settlement report ki fee lines fark samjha deti hain.

fixes.steps_en: I match the sales report with the settlement report by batch/settlement date and list what is still to arrive.
fixes.steps_hi: Main sales report aur settlement report ko batch/settlement date se match karke batata hoon kya abhi aana baaki hai.

fixes.steps_en: Refunds and chargebacks are taken out of the next payout. Add them back and the batch should tally.
fixes.steps_hi: Refund aur chargeback agle payout se katte hain. Inhe wapas jodo, batch tally ho jayega.

fixes.steps_en: I turn the settlement amounts into real numbers so the totals add up.
fixes.steps_hi: Main settlement amounts ko asli number bana deta hoon taaki total sahi jude.

verify.en: For each batch: gross sales - fees - refunds = amount credited by the bank.
verify.hi: Har batch ke liye: gross sales - fees - refund = bank mein aaya amount.

test_phrases: the bank got less money from card payments than we actually sold
card machine ki sale zyada thi par bank mein kam paisa aaya
कार्ड मशीन से बिक्री ज़्यादा हुई पर बैंक में कम पैसा आया

title_en: Intercompany balances don't match between group companies
title_hi: Group companies ke beech intercompany balance match nahi
symptoms: intercompany reconciliation not matching
dono companies ke books mein balance alag
group company ledger mismatch
subsidiary says different balance than us
related party confirmation not matching
इंटरकंपनी बैलेंस मेल नहीं खा रहा
सहायक कंपनी का बैलेंस हमारी किताबों से अलग
ic elimination difference
sister concern ke saath hisaab nahi mil raha
due to and due from not equal
head office ke ledger mein hamari company ka balance different hai
holding company shows a different balance for us
group company ki books mein hamara hisaab alag hai
मूल कंपनी में हमारा बैलेंस अलग

causes.title_en: Invoice or payment booked by only one company
causes.title_hi: Invoice ya payment sirf ek company ne book kiya

causes.title_en: Different exchange rates on the two sides
causes.title_hi: Dono taraf alag exchange rate

causes.title_en: Same transaction, different reference styles or text amounts
causes.title_hi: Wahi transaction, alag reference style ya text amounts

fixes.steps_en: Upload both ledgers; I list every entry that one company has and the other doesn't.
fixes.steps_hi: Dono ledger upload karo; main har woh entry dikhata hoon jo ek company mein hai aur doosri mein nahi.

fixes.steps_en: Agree one rate per transaction (usually the invoice-date rate) in both books; the rest is exchange gain/loss, not a mismatch.
fixes.steps_hi: Har transaction ke liye dono books mein ek rate (aksar invoice date ka) rakho; baaki exchange gain/loss hai, mismatch nahi.

fixes.steps_en: I clean spaces in references and amounts on both ledgers, then match again.
fixes.steps_hi: Main dono ledgers ke references aur amounts se space saaf karke dobara match karta hoon.

verify.en: Company A's balance with B equals company B's balance with A, every entry has a partner.
verify.hi: A ka B ke saath balance = B ka A ke saath balance, har entry ki jodi hai.

test_phrases: the amount our parent company shows against us is different from our books
holding company ke books mein hamara balance kuch aur dikh raha hai
मूल कंपनी की किताबों में हमारा बकाया अलग दिख रहा है
